source.revisionAuthority: containing Git commit; never a self-referential revision field

componentSourceAuthority: immutable component descriptors and publication locks selected by manifest.json
byteAuthority: Git blobs for instructions; declared SHA-256 and byte count for release assets
historyAuthority: previous Git commits and immutable release tags; not current consumer contracts
runtimeEvidenceAuthority: authenticated instance receipts bound to exact deployed component and task cuts
